verdict.rationale: Codegen supports task-driven implementation via Slack/Jira/Linear and can be given prompts to build features, and docs mention a Figma integration, but there is no evidence of a documented workflow for turning a design/mockup into a working implementation end-to-end without engineering setup. Missing for 10: detailed Figma-to-code workflow, PM-oriented UI/mockup ingestion, and any hands-on example of design-to-implementation without engineer involvement.
